examples.name: gaussian_v1.py
examples.title: 高斯模糊·变体1
examples.description: 不同半径的高斯模糊对比。（参数组 1）。
examples.code:
"""{title}
Pillow 图像处理示例。{desc}
运行后在当前目录生成 'pil_gaussian_v1'_preview.png。
"""
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter, ImageOps

base = Image.new("RGB", (420, 300), "#20242c")
dr = ImageDraw.Draw(base)
for i in range(7):
    x0 = 20 + i * (420 - 60) // 7
dr.rectangle([420 // 2 - 70, 300 // 2, 420 // 2 + 70, 300 - 30], outline="#e8e8e8", width=3)

result = base.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=0 + 1))
result.save("pil_gaussian_v1_preview.png")
print("已生成 pil_gaussian_v1_preview.png")

examples.description: 按渐变蒙版向纯色渐隐。（参数组 9）。
examples.code:
"""{title}
Pillow 图像处理示例。{desc}
运行后在当前目录生成 'pil_gradient-mask_v9'_preview.png。
"""
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter, ImageOps

base = Image.new("RGB", (612, 396), "#20242c")
dr = ImageDraw.Draw(base)
for i in range(7):
    x0 = 20 + i * (612 - 60) // 7
dr.rectangle([612 // 2 - 70, 396 // 2, 612 // 2 + 70, 396 - 30], outline="#e8e8e8", width=3)

mask = Image.linear_gradient('L').resize(base.size)
solid = Image.new('RGB', base.size, '#48dbfb')
result = Image.composite(base, solid, mask)
result.save("pil_gradient-mask_v9_preview.png")
print("已生成 pil_gradient-mask_v9_preview.png")
